pages.raw_meta: Priority Commerce is the payments and banking fintech that streamlines collecting, storing, lending, and sending money to unlock revenue opportunities.
raw_blocks: Priority Commerce is the payments and banking fintech that streamlines collecting, storing, lending, and sending money — helping businesses take advantage of revenue opportunities and accelerate cash flow. Since our founding in 2005, we’ve evolved from a successful payments processor to a full-fledged financial business partner. We’re now a nearly $1B company on Forbes’ list of America’s Most Successful Small-Cap Companies, CNBC’s list of the World’s Top Fintechs, and TIME’s list of America’s Growth Leaders.

Digital financial solutions evolve quickly. Priority Commerce’s tailored technology powers high-value commerce solutions that are delivered alongside industry-leading personalized support so you can thrive through changes. Your success is our success, which is why our connected commerce platform grows with you.
Founded in 2005 in Georgia as Priority Payment Systems, Priority Commerce began as a payments processor. Over the years, we strategically expanded our offerings and footprint:

We entered the commercial payments space in 2008. In 2015, we expanded through the acquisition of American Credit Card Processing Corp. We went public in 2018 on the NASDAQ under the ticker PRTH. In 2021, we acquired Finxera — now operating as CFTPay — to enhance our banking-as-a-service offerings. This was followed by the 2023 acquisition of Plastiq, which broadened our reach in B2B payments and spend management.

Today, we serve 1.8 million customer accounts, manage $1.7 billion in account balances, and process over $150 billion in transactions annually, solidifying our role as a major player in integrated payments and financial technology.

Priority Commerce works with businesses of all sizes, whether you’re a growing local company or a large enterprise. Our goal is to simplify how you move money so you can focus on running your business, not chasing payments.

We believe in partnership, transparency, and innovation. That means building solutions you can rely on, creating technology that grows with you, and continuously seeking ways to remove friction from your financial operations.

Most fintech providers solve just one piece of the puzzle. Priority Commerce has built an all-in-one ecosystem that helps you collect, store, lend, and send money. By keeping everything connected, we make it easier to accelerate cash flow and uncover new revenue opportunities.

At Priority Commerce, we’re constantly evolving—whether that’s investing in new technology or expanding through strategic acquisitions. By doing so, we continue to bring you smarter tools and more flexibility to manage your money in today’s fast-changing world.

Frequently Asked Questions About Merchant Services and Payment Processing

Merchant processing services allow businesses to accept and process electronic payments, including credit/debit cards, virtual cards, ACH transfers and mobile payments. These services ensure secure, fast and efficient transactions between customers and merchants.
Merchant service payment processing involves several key steps:
Transaction Initiation: The customer pays using a credit/debit card or mobile wallet.
Authorization: The payment processor verifies the transaction with the customer’s bank.
Approval: If approved, the merchant receives confirmation and the transaction is completed.

Settlement: The settlement stage finalizes the transaction by transferring the funds from the customer’s issuing bank to the merchant’s acquiring bank. With Priority Commerce’s processing solutions, businesses can receive same-day funding, ensuring faster access to cash flow.
When a payment is processed, the following steps occur:
Authorization Request: The payment processor submits the transaction to the customer’s bank.
Verification: The issuing bank confirms available funds.
Approval or Decline: The transaction is either approved or rejected.
Settlement: If approved, funds are transferred to the merchant’s account, typically within the same business day with Priority Commerce’s solutions.

This process ensures a secure, efficient transfer of funds. What sets Priority Commerce apart is that payment processing is just one part of a connected commerce engine. Our platform ties together payments, banking, vendor disbursements, and reporting in one system, helping businesses manage their full revenue cycle with speed, control and clarity.

Any business that accepts electronic payments — whether in retail , e-commerce, hospitality or services — needs merchant services. These services provide customers with flexible payment options, improve security and streamline transaction management.
A payment gateway securely transmits payment information between a merchant and a payment processor, ensuring data encryption.

Merchant services cover a broader range of financial solutions, including payment processing , merchant accounts and point-of-sale (POS) systems. While a gateway is a component of merchant services, the latter manages all aspects of payment acceptance and processing.
